description: This Java class implements an import handler for fixed deposit transactions within the Fineract platform. It processes an Excel workbook, reads fixed deposit transaction data, constructs command requests, and executes them to import deposit or withdrawal transactions for fixed deposit accounts.

classes.name: FixedDepositTransactionImportHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for importing fixed deposit transactions from an Excel workbook into the system, including reading data, processing transactions, and handling success/error reporting.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point that processes the Excel workbook, reads transactions, and imports them. Returns a Count of success and errors.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads the specified sheet in the workbook, parses transaction records, and returns a list of SavingsAccountTransactionData objects.

methods.name: readSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Parses a single row of data into a SavingsAccountTransactionData object, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Iterates over the list of transactions, constructs command requests for deposit or withdrawal, executes them, updates the sheet status, and returns success/error counts.
